native.query: SELECT a.name AS الحي, COUNT(*) AS عدد_الطلبات, SUM(reservations.use_package=0) AS مفردة, SUM(reservations.use_package=1) AS باقات, ROUND(AVG(CAST(reservations.total_price AS DECIMAL(12,2))),0) AS متوسط_القيمة, ROUND(100*COUNT(*)/SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (),1) AS نسبة_من_الرياض FROM reservations JOIN areas a ON a.id=reservations.area_id WHERE reservations.deleted_at IS NULL AND reservations.city_id=2 AND {{date}} GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY عدد_الطلبات DESC
